description: This file defines classes and methods for managing analytic default distributions, integrating with invoice lines, stock pickings, and sale order lines in an Odoo module. It includes data models, business logic for retrieving analytic accounts, and overrides for invoice line creation and stock picking behavior.

classes.name: account_analytic_default
classes.description: Data model for analytic distribution defaults, including logic to retrieve the best matching record based on multiple criteria.

classes.name: account_invoice_line
classes.description: Extension of invoice line to automatically assign analytic accounts based on product and partner.

classes.name: stock_picking
classes.description: Extension to retrieve analytic account information for stock pickings.

classes.name: sale_order_line
classes.description: Extension to set analytic accounts on invoice lines created from sale order lines.

methods.name: account_get
methods.description: Retrieve the most appropriate analytic default record based on product, partner, user, and date.

methods.name: product_id_change
methods.description: Update invoice line with the analytic account when product changes.

methods.name: _get_account_analytic_invoice
methods.description: Get analytic account ID for a stock picking move line.

methods.name: invoice_line_create
methods.description: Create invoice lines from sale order lines and assign analytic accounts.
